items.title: Zero Data Retention (ZDR): What It Means for AI APIs
items.summary: ZDR means an AI provider processes your prompt, returns a response, and doesn't store either one afterward. It's a retention guarantee, not a universal privacy policy. This page explains the boundary, compares ZDR with related controls, and shows how to enforce it at the account, guardrail, or request level.
